## Description

"Authorise prescription" is a separate action from signing the note (step-up auth). Server-side PDF (QuestPDF) in A4 and A5: clinic header/logo, doctor name, qualifications, licence number, signature image, patient identifiers, generic names first then brand, sig in the chosen language (English + local language), scheduled-drug notes, QR code to verify authenticity; stored with SHA-256 hash.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** An Rx cannot be printed or shared until authorised; authorisation is audited.
- [ ] **AC2.** PDF renders server-side for A4 and A5 and is stored with a hash; the QR verify page shows validity without exposing PHI beyond what the patient holds.
- [ ] **AC3.** Language option prints instructions in English plus Hindi/Tamil/Arabic (RTL correct) for the pilot languages.
- [ ] **AC4.** Each pilot doctor reviews and approves their own Rx layout (approval recorded per doctor; exit gate 4).
- [ ] **AC5.** Print layout passes 200 % zoom and screen-reader labelling checks in the on-screen preview.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
